source: Separate sprite sheets referenced against the approved Næsebladet character reference.
preparation: Transparent crops normalized onto 1254 × 1254 PNG canvases. The picker uses the existing WebP preparation step.

sheets.prompt:
Create a production sticker SPRITE ATLAS of exactly SIX separate bust illustrations of the SAME established leaf-nosed bat called Næsebladet from the image reference, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Landscape atlas with precisely 3 columns and 2 rows. Center coordinates fractions: (1/6,1/4), (1/2,1/4), (5/6,1/4), then (1/6,3/4), (1/2,3/4), (5/6,3/4). All stickers equally sized, each WELL INSIDE its own invisible square cell, leave at least 9% empty transparent safety margin on all sides. No panel, overlap, grid lines or ground. Cropped head and torso bust plus two broad wing-shoulders and listed prop, no feet. One clean distinct silhouette each in warm detailed hand-painted gouache and soft dry-brush fur texture. Preserve the source's exaggerated wide upright shoulders, angular folded umbrella wings with visible wing finger bones, large warm rust-colored ears including distinctive clean notch in the outer edge of his left ear (viewer right), very distinctive small pink pointed LEAF-shaped nose with veins, dark plum-brown woolly fur and rust cheek highlights, amber-brown skeptical eyes, determined slightly mischievous theatrical expression. Draw bat wings only, no separate human arms or hands; he manipulates compact props with the small free claws at his wing joints. Preserve broad silhouette and stable face proportions throughout. No long rabbit ears, no fangs, no clothing, no visible tail, no source spoon or recorder except when expressly requested. Keep props close to the body, symbols simple and readable at 48px. No labels, captions, backgrounds, shadows on ground, bright color halos, white outlines, watermarks or checkerboard. True alpha outside each sticker.

Bottom-middle: Næsebladet raises one little wing thumb beside a warm glowing light bulb, sly smile.
Bottom-right: Næsebladet tilts head beneath one clearly drawn muted teal question mark, one eyebrow raised.
